== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Galactic Union's Magic Tower{{!}}The Magic Tower is a prominent institution of the [[Galactic Union]] and serves as the central hub for the galaxy's magical community. Located on an artificial moon known as [[Moonfall]], the structure is a massive, polished [[steel]] spire that rises above the clouds and radiates colorful Aetheric light. While it is widely recognized as a school where hundreds of millions of mages have studied to become certified wizards, the educational facilities occupy only a small portion of its total space. In reality, the Tower functions as a vertical city comparable to a major colony, featuring ground-level docks for various shuttles and personal spacecraft. Though it is an influential cultural landmark, it is not considered a primary military target for the [[Legion]]. The facility is managed by various staff, including employees for maintenance and high-ranking officials such as the [[First Director]]. The institution has historically been led by enigmatic [[Archmagi]] with vast connections throughout magical society.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Galactic Union's Magic Tower{{!}}The Magic Tower is a polished [[steel]] spire that pierces the clouds, serving as both a school and a vertical city. This location features manicured lawns, a teacher's dock, and Sunsail frigates{{!}}Sunsail ships that can be picked up at the site. While its reputation provides protection for students, corporations are prohibited from operating within its system without receiving a special exemption. The tower maintains significant political reach within the [[Galactic Union]], leading [[Varic Vallenar]] to request its assistance against the [[Iron Legion]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As an institution of the [[Galactic Union]], the Magic Tower is governed by an enigmatic [[Archmage]] serving as its [[First Director]]. The tower maintains specific policies regarding student information and the distribution of class lists. Recently, the [[First Director]] completed a visit to Dornoth IV{{!}}Dornoth Four. While the organization has provided full support to Planetary [[Security]], it is currently working against the Captain.}}
